vote.q: Day 1. Sam has two days of food left and the laundromat generator is dead. Where does he go first?
opts: Rosie's walk-in freezer might still have canned food.
Painkillers and bandages before anything goes wrong.
Fuel for the generator, if the pumps aren't dry.
vote.how: Comment DINER, PHARMACY or GAS on the Day 1 Reel. One vote per account, your last comment counts.

survivors.name: Sam
survivors.bio: Holed up in the old laundromat on 3rd Street. Hasn’t seen another living person in weeks.

runs.loot: Painkillers and a roll of gauze from under the counter
Canned peaches and a tin of coffee from the walk-in
Two jerry cans of fuel and a case of bottled water
Six cans of beans from the stockroom
Plywood, a crowbar and a box of screws
Twelve rounds from behind the pawn counter
A pallet of army rations from a split container
A hunting rifle, a first aid kit and a trail map
A flare gun and a drum of aviation fuel
Two axes, a fire blanket and an oxygen tank
Canned soup and a shotgun with four shells
Unit 14: camping gear and a generator repair manual
Batteries and walkie-talkies from the electronics store
A crate of canned tuna from a split boxcar
Seed packets, a sack of feed corn and two very angry chickens
Candy, funnel cake mix and a megaphone
A flare kit, binoculars and a harbor chart with the island marked
A crossbow, a quiver of bolts and a strip of dried venison
A pallet of salted fish and a case of canned coffee
Seed trays, a sack of fertilizer and a hand pump
A crate of medical supplies addressed to Mercy Hospital
A radio log, two MREs and a box of 5.56 rounds under a cot
A gas mask, wool blankets and a pair of boots that almost fit
A string of bulbs, a toolbox from the mirror maze and a scare he won’t talk about
A sack of quarters, a car battery and the prize counter’s candy
Bags of feed, a stock trailer hitch and three goats that followed him home

missions.goal: Clear the ground floor and reach the basement generator.
missions.reward: Months of medicine and power for the hospital
missions.name: Mercy Hospital

missions.goal: Cut the chains and find out who locked themselves in.
missions.name: Police station

missions.goal: Clear the terminal so the planes can be reached.
missions.name: Airport terminal

missions.goal: Board the Mara and find what is moving in the hold.
missions.name: Cargo ship Mara

missions.goal: Cross to the island and take Blackrock. Someone keeps a lantern lit in the guard tower.
missions.name: Blackrock Penitentiary

missions.goal: Get through the gate of Fort Corran. Smoke has been rising from inside.
missions.name: Fort Corran

missions.goal: Power the KOAK tower and go on the air.
missions.crew: 1 engineer + 1 radio operator + the tower generator
missions.reward: Find out who keeps saying three words on 88.1
missions.name: KOAK radio tower
Clear the runway
missions.goal: Drag the burned jet off runway 27 so a plane can take off.

missions.name: Hollow Creek harvest
missions.goal: Bring in the corn and wheat before the frost, with guards on the barn roof.
missions.reward: A month of food for everyone

missions.name: The windmill pump
missions.goal: Get the old windmill pumping and fill the troughs again.
missions.reward: Clean water that needs no power

missions.name: Stray cattle
missions.goal: Round up the cattle that broke through the fence and wandered into the woods.
missions.reward: Milk now, and meat for the winter

missions.name: Fort Corran armory
missions.goal: Get through the inner fence and open the three ammo bunkers. One door is already hanging open.
missions.reward: Rifles, ammunition and body armor for every runner

missions.name: The Black Hawk
missions.goal: Refuel the helicopter on the east pad and get its rotor turning.
missions.crew: 1 pilot + 2 mechanics + aviation fuel from the airport
missions.reward: Air scouting over the whole map

missions.name: Smoke inside the fort
missions.goal: Somebody keeps a fire burning in the motor pool. Find out who before the horde does.
missions.reward: A new survivor, or a warning

missions.name: The big top
missions.goal: Something is still alive in the circus wagons, and one cage is torn open. Search the big top.
missions.reward: The tent as a shelter, and whatever was in the cage

missions.name: Light up the Ferris wheel
missions.goal: Get the midway generator running and turn the wheel into a beacon every survivor in Oakhaven can see.
missions.reward: A signal that brings new survivors in

missions.name: Stuck at the top
missions.goal: Something is moving in the top car of the Ferris wheel. Climb up or find a way to turn it.
missions.reward: Whoever, or whatever, is up there

missions.name: Interstate 9 pile-up
missions.goal: Clear one lane through the pile-up east of the city.

power.name: Laundromat generator
power.clue: Sam dragged it home from the auto shop. The carburetor is shot.
power.powers: A porch light and a floodlight over the yard

power.name: Gas station standby
power.clue: The kiosk kept a standby generator out back to run the pumps.
power.powers: The pumps, canopy lights and price sign

power.name: Rosie’s freezer generator
power.clue: Rosie ran the walk-in freezer off her own generator. Something in there still hums at night.
power.powers: The neon sign, the kitchen and a working freezer

power.name: Quay crane generator
power.clue: The cranes ran off a diesel set by the water.
power.powers: Quay floodlights, the cranes and Pier 9

power.name: Hangar ground power unit
power.clue: Hangar 2 had a ground power cart for starting planes.
power.powers: The control tower, runway lights and the terminal

power.name: Hospital emergency generator
power.clue: In the basement of Mercy Hospital, past the horde.

power.name: Lighthouse generator
power.clue: Out on the point. Only reachable by boat from the marina.
power.powers: The lighthouse beam, so ships can find the bay again

power.name: Mall backup generator
power.clue: The mall kept a backup generator by the loading dock for the food court freezers.
power.powers: Mall lights, the food court freezers and the cinema

power.name: Radio tower generator
power.clue: KOAK 88.1 has a diesel generator in a cage at the foot of the tower.
power.powers: The tower beacon and the transmitter. Oakhaven goes on the air.

power.name: Fort Corran field generator
power.clue: Army field generators sit on trailers in the motor pool. One of them still has fuel in it.
power.powers: The mast beacon, the gate and parade-ground floodlights, the range lights and the mess hall

power.name: Midway generator
power.clue: The carnival crew ran the rides off a trailer generator parked behind the bumper cars.
power.powers: The Ferris wheel lights, the midway bulbs, the drop tower and the arcade

power.name: City substation backup
power.clue: The substation by the woods has a diesel backup big enough for every street.
power.powers: Every streetlight, the pharmacy cross and the motel sign

milestones: A second survivor knocks on the laundromat door
Fix the laundromat generator: the first electric light in the city
A rooftop garden on the laundromat
Get the gas station pumps running
Restart the substation and turn the streetlights back on
Get the cargo ship’s engines running
Fly a plane out of the airport
